K1.text: Inherited from foundation v1.6.2, no clone-owned surface changed.

K2.text: Inherited from foundation v1.6.2, no clone-owned surface changed.

K3.text: All clone server actions are orgAction/ref-wrapped; public /p/[token] routes and the Twilio inbound route are documented public with token/signature as credential and a same-origin check.

K4.text: Clone reads/writes by id carry orgId (inOrg(ctx) or link-derived scope incl. eventId/personId); remaining findUniqueOrThrow calls take ids from already-scoped rows.

K5.text: Anonymous /p/[token] reads and all three POST routes go through readPersonLink, which uses the shared DB-backed hit() limiter per IP; the SMS webhook is signature-gated.

K6.text: Person links are hashed and expiring, but the clone removed no-referrer on /p/* (relies on global strict-origin-when-cross-origin, so same-origin Referer carries the token path) and has no per-link revoke; the only kill switch is rotating AUTH_SECRET.

K7.text: Global headers are unchanged; the clone only adds noindex/no-store for /p/*.

K8.text: Demo password gate hashes then timingSafeEquals, fails closed (503) on Vercel when unset; Twilio signature uses core safeEqual; cron route is the core guard.

K9.text: The Twilio inbound webhook verifies the signature but has no timestamp window and no idempotent claim (MessageSid is never recorded), so a captured signed request can be replayed and re-applied.

K10.text: No console/logger calls in clone code and no tokens or message bodies logged; SMS goes through the core outbox.

K11.text: DEMO_ACCESS_PASSWORD (and VERCEL) are read straight from process.env in the proxy/gate, bypassing src/core/env.ts, and DEMO_ACCESS_PASSWORD is missing from .env.example.

K12.text: Clone only adds Playwright env (DEMO_ACCESS_PASSWORD blank, workers 1) and its own port; test-DB guard and production-build webServer are untouched.

K13.text: Clone mutations audit via core audit() either in the action or the shared lib (broadcast.sent/resent, person.*, card.*, alert.resolve, assignment.*); the append-only DB enforcement is inherited.

K14.text: ignoreCommand is intact, port 4600 is the config default, and the cron stays on the core /api/cron guard (schedule changed to daily 13:00 UTC; the 5-minute day-of comment in cron-jobs.ts is a functional note, not a guard gap).
